title: Canyons 25K — Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 25K is 25 KM with 850 m of gain, starts in Downtown Auburn on Friday 23 April 2027 at 16:00 and has a 5-hour limit; the page shows 2 Running Stones while the 2026 main page shows 1.
The route goes from Robie Point over No Hands Bridge and the Training Hill into Cool, does a short loop and returns to Auburn.
The page still says 'New for 2026: the 25K will take place on Friday evening, April 24, 2026' while the 2027 start date is Friday 23 April 2027.
